title: Halide-mixing braking strategy for 1.95 eV wide-bandgap perovskites enabling high-efficiency triple-junction tandems
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,221-229
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE05574A, Paper
Zuxiong Xu, Jiashuo Han, Guang Li, Guoyi Chen, Dexin Pu, Hongyi Fang, Lishuai Huang, Jiahao Wang, Shiqiang Fu, Zixi Yu, Zhiqiu Yu, Kexin Ming, Yansong Ge, Shun Zhou, Guojia Fang, Weijun Ke
A new strategy to regulate uncontrolled growth in mixed-halide perovskites with >63% Br, enabling highly efficient 1.95 eV-bandgap perovskite solar cells and multi-terminal triple-junction all-perovskite tandems.
